# PCIe Subsystem (`pcie_ss`) RTL Module Boundary / Interface Checklist

**Source:** PCIE Subsystem Spec_v3.21, v3.21 (28 January 2026)
**Use:** RTL top-level port review for `pcie_ss` integration

---

## 1. Main Modules Summary

| # | Module | Hierarchy Role | Design Purpose | Evidence (Section / Page) |
|---|--------|---------------|----------------|--------------------------|
| M1 | **`pcie_top`** | Top-level wrapper | Instantiates all sub-modules; presents the unified `pcie_ss` boundary to SoC | §3 Fig. "芯片架构框图" (p.15), §4.19 Fig. (p.39) — VLM desc: "pcie_ss模块的内部结构，包含pcie_core、crg_noc、hotreset等子模块" |
| M2 | **`pcie_core`** (DWC PCIe Controller) | Controller IP | Synopsys DWC PCIe Gen5 EP controller; handles TL/DL/PL layers, LTSSM, iATU, DMA | §3.1 "子模块简介" (p.16–18); §4.1 "Controller" (p.18); TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_001/002: "32Gbps SerDes, Gen5 x16" |
| M3 | **PHY0–PHY3** (4× X4 PHY) | Physical layer | 4 independent X4 PHY instances composing X16; SerDes-based PIPE 5.1.1 interface | §1.12 "PHY" (p.8–9), PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1201: "4个X4 PHY组成X16"; §4.15.3 Fig. (p.37) |
| M4 | **`UPCS` / PIPE bridge** | Controller ↔ PHY interface | UPCS PIPE module bridging DWC controller to SerDes PHY via PIPE 5.1.1 | §3.1 "UPCS模块" (p.16); Fig. p.15 VLM: "UPCS PIPE模块"; §4.9 PIPE Interface signals (p.29) |
| M5 | **`PCIE_CRG` + `CFG_NOC`** | Clock/Reset Generator + Config NoC | Local PLL, clock domain generation (axi_clk, core_clk, cr_clk, pcie_cfg_clk), reset distribution, configuration NoC routing | §1.15 "PCIE CRG" (p.9–10); §4.4 "Clock" (p.21); Fig. 4-1 (p.21–22) |
| M6 | **`CFG` (Top CFG)** | Subsystem configuration | APB→CR protocol conversion; houses PCIe controller peripheral control registers, PHY control registers, top-level logic control registers | §3.1 "CFG模块" (p.16–17); §4.2 Address Map (p.20); §4.21 "Register description" (p.41) |
| M7 | **`TBU` (Translation Buffer Unit)** | IOMMU/SMMU | DTI interface to external TCU; together with TCU implements SMMUv3 for Inbound AXI Master address translation | §3.1 "TBU模块" (p.17); TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_050 |
| M8 | **`HotResetBlock`** | Hot Reset handler | Manages OutBound direction data flow during Hot Reset; controls flush timer (0–134ms), LTSSM enable gating, coordinates SoC reset | §3.1 "HotResetBlock" (p.17); §4.5.3 "Hot Reset" (p.23–24); §1.16 "Reset" (p.10) |
| M9 | **`Remap`** | Address remapping | 256-window Inbound address remap (discrete→contiguous); iATU operates in Bar Match Mode when Remap active; local AON configurable for config space protection | §3.1 "Remap模块" (p.17); §4.7 "ReMap" (p.28–29) |
| M10 | **`RASDP_GLUE`** | RAS/Debug/Statistics | Parity error aggregation, DES (Debug/Statistics/Error Injection) glue; event counters, time-based analysis, error injection, debug signal muxing | §3.1 "RASDP_GLUE模块" (p.16); §4.11 "PCIe RAS" (p.30–31); §4.13 Debug signal selection (p.34) |

## 2. Upstream Interfaces (SoC-facing)

| # | Interface | Direction | Width | Protocol | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|-----------|-----------|-------|----------|----------------|----------|
| U1 | **OB AXI4 Slave** | SoC → pcie_ss (In) | 512b data / 48b addr | AXI4 | OutBound data path from Main NoC to PCIe; max burst 256B, length≤4, size≤64B, 256 tags, supports NCBE MWr, INCR+WRAP, W-before-AW | §1.5 AXI, PCIE_MAS_REQ_AXI_SlAVE_501–507 (p.6) |
| U2 | **IB AXI4 Master** | pcie_ss → SoC (Out) | 512b data / 48b addr | AXI4 | InBound data path + DMA to Main NoC (via SMMUv3); max burst 256B, length≤4, size≤64B, 256 IDs, INCR only, QoS/user static config | §1.5 AXI, PCIE_MAS_REQ_AXI_MASTER_508–515 (p.6–7) |
| U3 | **CFG AXI-Lite** | SoC → pcie_ss (In) | 1× AXI-Lite | AXI4-Lite | Configuration bus; internal CFG_NOC routes to 9 slave spaces (Top CFG, CRG, PHYx4, MSIX2DBI, ReMap, DBI) | §1.5 PCIE_MAS_REQ_CFG_516–517 (p.7); §4.2 Address Map Table (p.20) |
| U4 | **DTI Interface** | pcie_ss → TCU (Out) | — | DTI (ARM) | TBU → TCU connection for SMMUv3 address translation | §3.1 "TBU模块: 通过DTI接口外接TCU" (p.17) |
| U5 | **ELBI bus** | — | — | ELBI | PCIe controller ELBI sub-controller; not used externally; must not hang if accessed | §1.5 PCIE_MAS_REQ_ELBI_518 (p.7) |

---

## 3. Downstream Interfaces (PHY / External-facing)

| # | Interface | Direction | Width | Protocol | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|-----------|-----------|-------|----------|----------------|----------|
| D1 | **PIPE Clock/Reset group** | PHY → Controller (In) | 6 signals | PIPE 5.1.1 | `pipe_msgbus_rst_n`, `pipe_rx_clk` (SerDes recovered clock), `pipe_rx_rst_n`, `mac_phy_pclk_rate`(O), `mac_phy_maxpclkreq_n`(O), `phy_mac_maxpclkack_n`(I) | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| D2 | **PIPE Data Interface** | Bidirectional | depends on width config | PIPE 5.1.1 | `phy_mac_rxdata`(I), `mac_phy_txdata`(O), `mac_phy_txdatavalid`(O), `mac_phy_rxwidth`(O), `mac_phy_width`(O) | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| D3 | **PIPE Message Bus** | Bidirectional | — | PIPE 5.1.1 | `mac_phy_messagebus`(O), `phy_mac_messagebus`(I) — PHY management commands | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| D4 | **PIPE Status Interface** | PHY → Controller (In) / Bidirectional | 7 signals | PIPE 5.1.1 | `phy_mac_rxvalid`, `phy_mac_rxelecidle`, `mac_phy_txelecidle`(O), `phy_mac_rxstatus`, `phy_mac_phystatus`, `mac_phy_pclkchangeack`(O), `phy_mac_pclkchangeok` | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| D5 | **CR Bus (per PHY)** | pcie_ss → PHY | — | CR (Configuration Ring) | APB→CR converted access to each PHY's internal register space and SRAM | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1210 (p.9) |
| D6 | **PHY SRAM Load** | pcie_ss ↔ PHY | — | Custom | FW load path for PHY SRAM boot (mode 3: bypass ROM from config bus); `phy_ss_reg.phyX_sram_ctrl.sram_ext_ld_done` handshake | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1207–1209 (p.9); §4.20.1 Init sequence (p.39–41) |

## 4. Clock Architecture

| # | Clock Domain | Source | Frequency | Fan-out Modules | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|-------------|--------|-----------|-----------------|----------------|----------|
| C1 | **`pad_ref_clk_p/n`** (differential) | External 100MHz oscillator → PHY0 pad | 100 MHz | PHY0 → PHY1/2/3 (daisy chain) | Primary PHY reference clock (mode 1: daisy chain; mode 2: all from PAD; mode 3: from Local PLL) | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1203–1205 (p.8–9); §3.1 "外部时钟" (p.16) |
| C2 | **`axi_clk`** | PCIE_CRG local PLL | 1 GHz (functional) / 2 GHz (test max) | AXI master, AXI slave, TBU, Remap, HotResetBlock | Data-path clock; PLL ref from PHY 100MHz (normal) or ref_clk 20MHz (debug) | §1.15 PCIE_MAS_REQ_CRG_1501–1504 (p.9–10); §4.4.1 "时钟介绍" (p.22) |
| C3 | **`core_clk`** | PCIe lane0 1GHz max pclk → divided | depends on lane rate | PCIe controller core logic | Controller logic clock; asynchronous to pipe_rx_clk; dynamically switched with aux_clk via GFM (no CDC between core_clk/aux_clk) | §1.15 PCIE_MAS_REQ_CRG_1506 (p.10); §4.4.1 (p.22) |
| C4 | **`aux_clk`** | GFM | — | PCIe controller | Low-power mode clock; switched from core_clk via GFM; no CDC between core_clk and aux_clk | §4.4.1 (p.22) |
| C5 | **`pipe_rx_clk`** | PHY SerDes recovered | depends on lane rate | PCIe controller PIPE RX interface | PIPE receive data recovery clock; asynchronous to core_clk | §4.4.1 (p.22); §4.9 (p.29) |
| C6 | **`cr_clk`** (also `cr_para_clk`) | PCIE_CRG local PLL | 125 MHz | PHY CR interface | PHY configuration register access clock | §1.15 PCIE_MAS_REQ_CRG_1504 (p.10); §4.4.1 (p.22) |
| C7 | **`pcie_cfg_clk`** | PCIE_CRG | 250 MHz | CFG_NOC, system registers | NoC and system register logic clock | §4.4.1 (p.22) |
| C8 | **`local_ref_clk`** (lock_phy_ref_clk) | PCIE_CRG local PLL | 100 MHz | PHY (backup) | Backup/debug reference clock for PHY | §1.15 PCIE_MAS_REQ_CRG_1504 (p.10); §4.15.3 (p.37); §4.4.1 (p.22) |
| C9 | **AMBA clock** | external (AMBA domain) | — | AMBA interfaces | Asynchronous to core clock domain | §4.4.1 (p.22) |

## 5. Reset Architecture

| # | Reset Signal | Polarity | Domain Scope | Trigger Source | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|-------------|----------|-------------|----------------|----------------|----------|
| R1 | **`power_up_rst_n`** | active low | Full chip cold reset | Power-on / Warm reset | Hardware cold reset from CRG to Core; full chip reset in Warm Reset scenario | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) VLM: "CRG生成power_up_rst_n"; §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_WarmReset_1605 (p.10) |
| R2 | **`PERST#`** | active low | PCIe controller + PHY | PCIe external PAD input | PCIe fundamental reset; de-assertion triggers LTSSM entry to Detect; controls warm reset of controller and PHY | §3.1 "PERST#控制器的perst_n" (p.16); §4.17 PAD (p.38–39) |
| R3 | **`par_rst_n`** | active low | Core (parallel domain) | CRG | Parallel reset for core logic | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) |
| R4 | **`phy_rst_n`** | active low | PHY modules | CRG | PHY reset from CRG to Core and PHY | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) |
| R5 | **`phy_pwr_rst_n`** | active low | PHY power domain | CRG | PHY power-on reset | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) |
| R6 | **`sticky_rst_n` / `non_sticky_rst_n`** | active low | Core sticky/non-sticky registers | CRG | Sticky vs non-sticky register reset (preserve some state across certain resets) | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) |
| R7 | **`pipe_msgbus_rst_n`** | active low | PIPE message bus domain | PHY | Reset for pipe_clk domain message bus | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| R8 | **`pipe_rx_rst_n`** | active low | PIPE RX clock domain | PHY | Reset for pipe_rx_clk domain | §4.9 PIPE Interface Table (p.29) |
| R9 | **Hot Reset** (logical) | — | SoC (NOT pcie_ss except HotResetBlock/TBU/ReMap) | Upstream TS1 with Hot Reset bit=1 | Hot Reset flushes pending transactions; controller drives `hot_reset_int` to SoC; flush timer 0–134ms; `app_ltssm_enable` gated | §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_HotReset_1601–1603 (p.10); §4.5.3 (p.23–24); §4.5.3.2 (p.24) |
| R10 | **Link Disable** | — | Same as Hot Reset | Software | Treated identically to Hot Reset | §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_Disable_1604 (p.10) |
| R11 | **FLR (Function Level Reset)** | — | — | — | NOT supported | §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_FLR_1606 (p.10) |
| R12 | **`sync_pend_n`** | active low | Core | CRG | Synchronization pending reset | Fig. §4.5.1 (p.23) |

## 6. PAD / Sideband Signals

| # | Signal | Direction | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|--------|-----------|----------------|----------|
| P1 | **`CLKREQ#`** | Input PAD | L1 SubState reference clock gate control; asserted low to request refclk | §4.17 PAD (p.38–39) |
| P2 | **`WAKE#`** | Output PAD | L2/L3 wake-up control; asserted to request link reactivation | §4.17 PAD (p.38–39) |

## 7. Interrupt Outputs (SoC-facing summary)

| # | Signal | Width | Type | Design Purpose | Evidence |
|---|--------|-------|------|----------------|----------|
| I1 | **`irq_func`** | 1 | Summary | Aggregated functional interrupts (link events, flush done, PLL lock, etc.) | §4.6.1 Summary IRQ Table (p.26) |
| I2 | **`irq_err`** | 1 | Summary | Aggregated error interrupts (uncorrectable, ECRC, bad TLP, etc. — 15 error types) | §4.6.1 Summary IRQ Table (p.26) |
| I3 | **`edma_int`** | 32 | Individual | DMA channel completion/error interrupts (level); 16 read + 16 write channels | §4.6.1 Summary IRQ + Source Tables (p.25–26); §1.8 HDMA (p.7) |
| I4 | **`tbu_ras`** | 1 | Individual | TBU/ATC RAS interrupt | §4.6.1 (p.26) |
| I5 | **`tbu_pmu`** | 1 | Individual | TBU/ATC performance monitor interrupt | §4.6.1 (p.26) |
| I6 | **`phy_sram_sec_irq`** | 1 | Individual | PHY SRAM corrected (single-bit) ECC error | §4.6.1 irq_src table (p.26) |
| I7 | **`phy_sram_ded_irq`** | 1 | Individual | PHY SRAM uncorrected (double-bit) ECC error | §4.6.1 irq_src table (p.26) |
| I8 | **`ctl_rasdp_irq`** | 1 | Individual | PCIe controller parity error (aggregated from multi-bit parity) | §4.6.1 irq_src table (p.26); §4.11 RAS (p.30) |

**Raw interrupt sources (37 total):** includes `hot_reset_int`, `wr_ost_flush_done`, `rd_ost_flush_done`, `all_ost_flush_done`, `perst_int`, `link_down_event_int`, `ltssm_into_gen5_int`, `phy_pll_lock/unlock_int`, `pll_lost_lock_int`, `remap_err_irq`, `radm_trgt1_atu_cbuf_err`[16], 15 error types, etc. — full list at §4.6.1 Tables (p.25–26).

## 9. PHY Lane Configuration

| Parameter | Value | Evidence |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| PHY count | 4 × X4 PHY = X16 total | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1201 (p.8) |
| Supported lane widths | x1, x2, x4, x8, x16 | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1202 (p.8) |
| SerDes rate | 32 Gbps (Gen5) | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_001–002 |
| PIPE version | 5.1.1 | §4.9 Table caption (p.29) |
| Reference clock modes | 3 modes (daisy-chain, parallel PAD, Local PLL) | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1203–1205 (p.8–9) |
| Clocking schemes | CC (Common Clock) + SRIS/SRNS (Separate Clock) | §4.15.5 (p.37–38) |
| Power states | L0, L1, L0s; L1 substates NOT supported; L1 CPM (Clock PM) supported | §4.12.1 Note (p.31); §4.12.3.4 (p.33) |
| PHY boot modes | ROM direct, SRAM from ROM, Bypass ROM from config bus | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_PHY_1207–1209 (p.9) |
| PHY SRAM | ECC protected (single + double bit error reporting) | §1.12 PCIE_MAS_REQ_SRAM_ECC_1213 (p.9) |

## 10. Key Design Constraints

| Constraint | Detail | Evidence |
|------------|--------|----------|
| Controller mode | EP mode only | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_006 (p.15) |
| SR-IOV | NOT supported | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_153 (p.29) |
| FLR | NOT supported | §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_FLR_1606 (p.10) |
| Atomic/Barrier/Fence | NOT supported | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_150–152 (p.29) |
| HDMA channels | 16 read + 16 write channels, 256 tags | §1.8 HDMA (p.7) |
| MSI vectors | 32 vectors, per-vector enable | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_450–451 (p.34) |
| MSI-X vectors | 14 vectors, Table/PBA in memory, software trigger only | §4.6.2.2 (p.26–27) |
| MSI-X hardware trigger | Supported (14 interrupt inputs → AXI write → doorbell → MSI-X TLP) | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_464 (p.35); Fig. p.27 |
| BAR configuration | 1× 64b MEM BAR + 1× 32b REG BAR + 1× 32b internal register BAR; 2 Resize BARs (1MB–512GB) | TRS REQ_PCIE_TRS_043/240–241 |
| ELBI bus | Not used externally; must not hang | §1.5 PCIE_MAS_REQ_ELBI_518 (p.7) |
| Hot Reset flush timer | 0–134ms programmable timeout; default 2µs | §1.16 PCIE_MAS_REQ_HotReset_1601 (p.10); §4.5.3.2 (p.24) |
